name: quotes
note: Hand-made, not recorded (Yahoo answers only yahoo-finance2's own User-Agent, and none was recorded here): Yahoo's v7 quote answer, one row per symbol, in the shape yahoo-finance2 4.0.6's quote schema validates (QuoteBase's required fields, contractSymbol for a future), with invented values as of 2026-11-25, for the 83 symbols of the market views that test/fork/fixtures/yahoo does not already quote (^GSPC, CL=F, EURUSD=X and BTC-USD come from there). A test answers each batched request with the rows of the symbols it asks for, as Yahoo leaves out symbols it does not know.
